{{Quote|We built this underwater base to ''protect'' our oceans from Separatist infiltration!|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="Colony Crisis" />}}
An '''underwater base''' was located on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Mon_Calamari_underwater_base2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The underwater base protected by [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone SCUBA troopers]]]]
The underwater base was built by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to protect their [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion. After a [[colony creature]] sent a horde of [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] to [[Attack on the Mon Calamari underwater base|attack]] the facility, the base was relocated to another location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
